newsitem.title: USA: Donna Karan expected to cut costs - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Donna Karan expected to cut costs - NYT.

text.p: Donna Karan International Inc, which held its initial public offering last June, is expected to put forth a cost-cutting plan designed to get the fashion house back on track, the New York Times said.
In Wednesday's edition, the Times said the move comes as Wall Street analysts and investors believe Donna Karan, the chief executive of the company bearing her name, spends too much money.
The cost-cutting initiatives could be announced as early as Wednesday, it said.
The Times said that the company's costs are growing much faster than sales.
The Times said Karan declined to be interviewed.
